task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Open the drawer of the cabinet with metal reinforcements and move the computer mouse into it.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架即可打开金属加固的柜子抽屉，将电脑鼠标移入其中。
